events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare web copy vs 4K master mtime and duration
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-walkthroughs && for t in kie stripe hubspot zoho wistia; do d=scripts/walkthroughs/wt-review/$t; [ -d $d ] || d=$(dirname $(find . -path "*wt-review/$t/web/$t.mp4" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head -1))/..; m=$(ls $d/*4k*.mp4 2>/dev/null | head -1); w=$d/web/$t.mp4; echo "$t master=$(stat -f %m $m) $(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 $m) web=$(stat -f %m $w) $(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 $w)"; done; git status --short | wc -l; git log -1 --oneline
